title: Proposal Plan
description: The slide-by-slide build plan. Stage 2 writes the outline and requirement map; Stage 3 fills in content and sources; Stage 4 builds from it; Stage 5 audits against it.

brief_ref.description: Path to the rfp_brief.json this plan answers

path.description: The firm's approved .potx/.pptx — required; never build without one

cut_for_length.description: Sections dropped to fit the limit, lowest evaluation weight first. Reported at handover.

title.description: Client-facing section title — mirrors the RFP's wording when it prescribes a structure

requirement_ids.description: Requirements this section answers. Union across all sections must cover every ID in the brief.

layout.description: Layout name or index from template_profile.json — must exist in the approved template

blocks.description: Content units placed into the layout's placeholders

placeholder.description: Placeholder name/idx from the template profile

kind.description: Use 'text' for placeholders the layout already wraps in an element of its own (a title slot, a column heading); 'heading' emits its own <h3> and nests wrongly there. 'phases' and 'members' take arrays of objects — see the renderer.

content.description: String for prose, array for bullets, object for table/metric

sources.description: Knowledge-bank entry IDs this content came from. MUST be non-empty unless gap is true — no third state.

gap.description: True when the knowledge bank has no coverage. Renders as a visible [GAP] marker; never substitute generated filler.

gap_note.description: Required when gap is true — what is missing and which requirement it leaves exposed
